data.content:
I submitted the dispute for DD-51115 for owner approval. The first attempt was rejected, so I resubmitted once and the second went through.

The rejection had two causes:
- The wording check flagged "lied", which was matching inside the word "applied". I reworded it.
- The order ticket is neutral evidence, since it shows Jhol Momo was ordered but not that it was packed. It can't be cited as support, so the dispute now cites only the pickup evidence [DD-51115:pickup_handoff]: ready at 12:55, picked up at 12:58. The ticket is mentioned in the text without a citation.

The dispute asks for the $17.50 deduction to be reviewed and reversed, and it makes no claims about the customer.
